purpose: Quint実行・検証の依存境界をNode/Bunで実測
用途ごとの最小ランタイムを選択
誤って検証済みとすることを防止
同じ入力・比較条件を再実行できる
仕様と実装の差を早期発見
品質維持の作業量を削減
高利益率で品質を維持
事業の継続収益を高める
譲渡可能な低属人性の法人資産を形成
高価値法人の構築と売却

rule: TLA+版PRの実行コードを複製しない。Quint固有の検査を独立配置し共有の評価形式のみ揃える。

Quint and TLA+ use separate thin runners; share evidence result format but do not generalize verification engines. Temporarily downloaded native distributions stay outside evidence; re-run by fixed direct versions. Explicitly decline direct Z3/JAR isolation claims.
scope: Quint 0.33.1, Node 22.16.0, Bun 1.3.0, Linux x86-64, Apalache 0.62.4, Rust evaluator v0.7.1

finding: TLC backend cannot verify the counter with its Apalache-distribution JAR removed, exit=1. Both JVM and JAR-removal controls verified.

design: Keep separate Quint/TLA+ runners, same sourceSha256 and evidence model. Native JAR test now supported; native Z3 absent scenario remains untested. Parent proof observability can be addressed independently.
